seo.title: ODDnetwork — stay involved beyond a single event
seo.description: A developing year-round model for organisations that want to stay involved with ODD beyond one ticket, partnership or project — being shaped with the first organisations involved.

title: Some relationships should not reset after every event.
intro: We are building a year-round model for organisations that want to stay involved with ODD beyond one ticket, partnership or project. The final shape is not fixed yet. We are developing it with the first organisations interested in taking part.

whyThisExists.headline: Useful relationships need more than annual peaks.
whyThisExists.body: Events are good at creating first encounters. They are less good at giving people enough time to understand each other, follow an idea, or find the right moment to work together. ODDnetwork is an attempt to create that continuity for organisations around ODD — without turning every interaction into a sponsorship package or a networking event.

whatWeAreShaping.headline: We are designing the model around actual use.
whatWeAreShaping.body: The working idea includes small conversations and gatherings, relevant ways into ODD activity across the year, and introductions when there is a real reason for people to meet. We do not want to publish a long benefits list before we know which parts are genuinely useful.
